product_metadata.title: Fun Express Big Head Gingerbread Ornaments | 1-Pack | 12 Count | Christmas Tree Decor for Holiday Season and Yuletide Celebrations
features: CHRISTMAS-THEMED SUPPLIES - Have yourself a more joyous celebration as these fun and creative supplies fit the holiday motif.
GINGERBREAD DETAILS - Add classic details to your Christmas tree as you accentuate with a family of smiling gingerbread, bringing a unique touch to the decorations.
ATTRACTIVE HOLIDAY COLORS - Each piece is clad in clothes colored in a classic and joyous array of red, white, and green, each finished with glitter.
COMPLETING THE CHRISTMAS TREE - Utilize these big head gingerbread ornaments on your tree. Each pack comes with 12 pieces.
PREMIUM MATERIAL CONSTRUCTION - Made from durable resin material to deliver a long-lasting quality that lives through the full holiday season.
description: Gingerbread people are ready knocking on your doors! Amp up the decorations with the Fun Express Big Head Gingerbread Ornaments!

Made from hardwearing resin material, these uniquely made ornaments will surely jazz up your Christmas tree! It offers a unique and sweet detail with intricately made 3 1/2" gingerbread people. Each piece is clad in the festive colors of Christmas: red, green, and white; finished with a glittery finish.
These Gingerbread Ornaments from Fun Express can also be used as easy last-minute party decorations for a more memorable Yuletide celebration!
